title: Remove obsolete Go scaffold and inference leftovers
description: Remove the obsolete Go model-serving scaffold and close leftover inference/Go-shell paths so the repository matches the Rust-first Compute OS kernel.

logs.msg: Deleted cmd/, internal/, proto/, gen/, migrations/, Go module, Makefile, docker-compose, buf/sqlc, and Go CI. Closed deferred vLLM/direct-agent tasks. Locked no-Go-shell decision in current docs.
